**Following [[boycott]]s in [[Croatia]] on January 24, and in conjunction with a follow-up boycott in the country, residents of [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]], [[Serbia]], [[Montenegro]], and [[North Macedonia]] start a boycott of [[retail|retail stores]] in response to rising prices.
